response.reasoning: The two predicates, `in domain_1: (offers ?e - entity ?i - item)` and `in domain_2: (has ?e - entity ?i - item)`, both describe a relationship between an entity and an item. The predicates `offers` and `has` are essentially synonyms in this context, representing the idea that an entity possesses or is offered an item. The arguments (`?e` for entity and `?i` for item) are also identical. Therefore, they can be merged into a single predicate that captures this fundamental relationship. The predicates are not containing relationships, so no complexity will be introduced.
